question.text: What changes are observed within each complete subject from Baseline to Week 8 in each declared group?
question.population_or_system: the 12 study units with two measurements in paired.csv
question.comparison_or_exposure: Week 8 versus Baseline within subject, shown separately by declared group

estimands.population_or_system: the 12 complete study units in paired.csv
estimands.contrast_or_exposure: Week 8 minus Baseline within subject, stratified by declared group
estimands.summary_measure: individual observed change and median within-group change
estimands.effect_scale: difference in original response units; positive means an increase at Week 8
estimands.adjustment_or_aggregation: one difference per complete subject; the median is calculated separately within each declared group
estimands.missing_data_policy: complete-pair description; a unit missing either timepoint is excluded and counted

claims.statement: The figure describes all 12 complete-subject changes and the median change within each declared group.
claims.scope: the complete pairs supplied in paired.csv
claims.not_claimed: The observed change is statistically significant, generalizes beyond the included units, or was caused by an intervention.

primary: Baseline and Week 8 response linked by subject
diagnostics: exactly one Baseline and one Week 8 row per subject

panels.question: What direction and magnitude of change does each complete pair show?
panels.quantity_and_units: response and within-unit change in declared units

encoding.geometry: raw paired points connected within study unit with a descriptive change summary
encoding.position: Baseline and Week 8 on x, observed response on y
encoding.color: neutral points and lines with one accent for the change summary
encoding.scale_and_limits: linear response scale spanning every observed value with padding

statistics.center: median Week 8-minus-Baseline change within each group
statistics.uncertainty: not-applicable: no inferential or spread interval is drawn
statistics.test_or_model: not-applicable: no inferential paired test is performed
statistics.multiplicity: not-applicable: no hypothesis tests are performed
statistics.n_definition: 12 subjects with both Baseline and Week 8 values

panels.unique_contribution: preserves pairing, direction, and magnitude for every complete study unit
known_risks: connecting rows by display order instead of subject would corrupt pairing
complete-pair summaries do not describe units with a missing timepoint

data_integrity.missingness: the example fixture has one Baseline and one Week 8 value for every subject

transformations.operation: calculate Week 8 minus Baseline after pivoting by subject
transformations.guard: require exactly one finite row per subject and timepoint and a stable group before subtraction

data_integrity.aggregation: one paired_change per subject; median change is summarized separately within Control and Treatment

limitations: description is restricted to complete pairs and contains no inferential test

visual_system.emphasis: within-unit trajectories first, descriptive change summary second

color_semantics.accent: descriptive summary only; it does not encode significance

review_risks.risk: pair identity could be lost during reshape or plotting
review_risks.mitigation: validate unique subject-timepoint keys and retain subject in analysis-table.csv

acceptance: all 12 pair IDs have exactly two source rows and one calculated paired_change
every line connects values with the same subject
the descriptive within-group median change reproduces analysis-table.csv
SVG, PDF, and PNG match the declared physical size and PNG DPI
the final SVG has editable text and no clipping
